# McCollins Media

> McCollins Media is a digital marketing agency based in Dubai Media City, Dubai, UAE. It offers brand development, web development, performance marketing, SEO, marketing automation, content production, social media marketing and Google Ads, with a data-driven, globally minded approach and transparent reporting.

McCollins Media works across industries including real estate, luxury, food & beverage, technology, startups and B2B. Brands featured on the site include Toshiba, Pioneer, Costa Coffee, Fujifilm, Wagamama, RTA, Energizer and Damac.

## Services

- [Brand Development](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/brand-development): Cohesive brand identities for global audiences
- [Web Development](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/web-development): High-performance, responsive, conversion-focused websites
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/performance-marketing): Data-driven, cross-border campaigns focused on ROI
- [SEO](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/seo): Search engine optimization
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/marketing-automation): Automation for sustainable, consistent growth
- [Content Production](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/content-production): Cinematic, strategy-led content
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/social-media-marketing): Community building and engagement through social content
- [Google Ads](https://www.mccollinsmedia.com/services/google-ads): Paid search and advertising management
